news: Binance: $6.3B hack began with a fake job offer
Binance says North Korea-linked attackers spent five months on the Oct 29 breach, starting with a fake recruitment test. It has replaced 98% of affected assets; customers bear no losses.
CEO Paolo Ardoino says 50,000 BTC more than its reserve report shows are held as company investments. The extra coins are not independently verified and are not new purchases.
Tesla and SpaceX block OKX-ICE token stocks
Six more companies, incl. Amazon and Netflix, objected to their shares trading on the planned OKX-ICE tokenized-stock venue. The total is now 56 companies.
